interpretation_notes: Section 3 'minimum history: the value 20 days earlier exists' is a transform computability requirement: both the current value and the value 20 source-business-days earlier must be point-in-time available at the Origin's T_info. It is NOT a statistical warm-up parameter (no '20 observations' warm-up is introduced).
